name: Lightbox
description: Modal image viewer with keyboard navigation across a gallery of images.

criteria.statement: Required stories produce no axe violations at the configured severity.
criteria.note: No fresh a11y evidence for 'axe-no-violations'; run npm run test:stories:matrix:ci to capture.

criteria.statement: The accessibility tree (role, name, state) matches the committed snapshot for every required story.
criteria.note: No fresh a11y evidence for 'accessibility-tree'; run npm run test:stories:matrix:ci to capture.

criteria.statement: The component remains legible and operable under a real browser forced-colors: active pass.
Positional, scale, and opacity motion is suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.
Every documented keyboard interaction works as specified.
Documented ARIA roles, states, and properties are present on the rendered output.
criteria.note: No fresh a11y evidence for 'accessibility-tree'; run npm run test:stories:matrix:ci to capture.

governance.note: Promoted out of the bespoke/infrastructure exemption: a generic image viewer consumed by ProjectGallery and others, not app infrastructure. Already DS-shaped (CSS module, @dt/Icon, portal, focus restore). Alpha because forced-colors and light/dark are unverified.
